top_signals.title: Fed Used Treasury Funds to Support Yen in Joint Intervention
top_signals.summary: The Federal Reserve said on Wednesday that the US participation with Japan in intervening to support the Japanese yen in late July was a Treasury Department move, and that its own funds weren’t involved.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: PE Isn’t Slowing its Poaching of Bankers: Friedland
top_signals.summary: David Friedland, co-head of North America investment banking at Citi, joins Dani Burger on "Bloomberg Deals." Private equity firms are still aggressively poaching talented young bankers from Wall Street despite indications last year that they would slow down. (Source: Bloomberg)
